title: Petra $70, Machu Picchu $43 — the Great Wall? Just $6 | China Travel Expert
description:
The world's great wonders are expensive to stand in front of — except one. Petra in Jordan runs about $70 for a single day. Machu Picchu is roughly $43 to enter. The Taj Mahal is about $16 for foreign visitors. The Great Wall of China? Around ¥45 (~$6) at Mutianyu — a tenth of Petra's gate, for one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

Cheaper doesn't mean lesser. Same bucket-list tier, a fraction of the price — which might make the Great Wall the best-value wonder on the planet.

🧭 Expert Tip: go early and book cable-car tickets online — the lifts up the Wall sell out by midday in peak season, and the morning light beats the crowds.
